message: Hi Alex, it's Marcus at Luna Hair Studio, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Marcus, thanks for the honest question. I can't promise a customer number — no one honestly can, and anyone who does is guessing. What I can promise: I'll fix the real problems on your site (speed, mobile, broken booking flow, whatever's costing you visitors) for $900 flat. If you want ongoing upkeep after, it's $250/month. Happy to send the audit either way.
